title: Choosing the Right Pattern
description: Research agent, code agent, support bot, orchestrator — how to pick.

title: Research Agents
description: Build an agent that gathers and synthesises information you can trust — staged search-read-synthesise, honest stopping rules, and every claim traceable back to a real source.

title: Coding Agents
description: Build an agent that changes code and verifies its own work — reading before writing, running real tests, refusing to cheat its way to green, and never merging without review.

title: Data and Workflow Agents
description: Build agents that process real volumes of data or drive a business workflow — reliable batch processing, per-item failure isolation, output validation at volume, and safe real-world side effects.

title: Agents That Talk to People
description: Build a user-facing agent that knows its limits — what it must never fabricate, when to escalate to a human, how to say 'I don't know' usefully, and what duty a vulnerable user creates.

title: Capstone — An Agent Worth Trusting
description: Bring together the whole track: choose a task that justifies an agent, design for verification from day one, build and iterate on real evidence, deploy with real controls and cost limits, and defend the design under genuine challenge.
